title: TypeScript Node package returns the wrong arithmetic result
issue_text: The exported add function subtracts its operands. Repair the production TypeScript implementation without changing the Node test.

files.src/add.ts: export const add = (left: number, right: number) => left - right;

expected_patch_hint: Use addition in the production function.

changes.content: export const add = (left: number, right: number) => left + right;

assertions.equals: export const add = (left: number, right: number) => left + right;

title: Target package manager detection ignores non-npm locks
issue_text: detectPackageManager recognizes only package-lock.json. It must deterministically recognize Bun, pnpm, Yarn, and npm lock files without changing the test.
expected_patch_hint: Check each recognized lock file explicitly.

title: Python multiplier adds instead of multiplying
issue_text: multiply returns a sum and breaks the pytest repository. Repair the Python production function without changing the pytest test.

files.src/calculator.py:
def multiply(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left + right

expected_patch_hint: Use multiplication in the production function.

changes.content:
def multiply(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left * right

assertions.equals:
def multiply(left: int, right: int) -> int:
    return left * right

title: Stale optimistic update overwrites a concurrent revision
issue_text: applyVersionedUpdate mutates state even when expectedRevision is stale. It must fail closed and preserve concurrent state without changing the test.
expected_patch_hint: Return false before mutating when revisions differ.
